skills.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to generate a structured, auditable, business-grade daily news briefing from specified sources. The skill supports customizable themes (AI, chips, new energy, finance, consumer, healthcare, etc.), selectable content types (政策法规, 融资并购, 产品发布, 技术突破, 市场数据, 行业分析, 人事变动, 财报业绩, 行业趋势, 竞品动态, 供应链, 国际合作), sectors, regions, and languages. It produces output in markdown, plaintext, or JSON format with verifiable source links. Suitable for analysts, investors, managers, and AI agents who need decision-grade news intelligence.
